title: World's End Harem
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A 'Man-Killer Virus' has killed 99.9 percent of men while Reito Mizuhara lay in cryogenic sleep. He wakes five years later to find that he and four other surviving men are expected to father children with as many women as possible under a female-run world government. Reito refuses and searches for his missing girlfriend Erisa, uncovering a conspiracy, while another survivor, Doi, indulges fully. Seven Seas publishes it under its Ghost Ship adult imprint.
life_message: Its hero holds that fidelity and the truth matter more than the pleasure a society offers him, though the story itself dwells on that pleasure.
